Class MonitoringStatusColors

java.lang.Object
ecmwf.ecpds.master.plugin.http.controller.monitoring.MonitoringStatusColors
public final class MonitoringStatusColors extends Object
Configurable colors for the status scales shown throughout the Monitor UI.

Overrides are stored in SYS_CONFIG under the MonitoringColors group. The short-lived cache avoids a remote database lookup for every status badge; changes made in this Monitor are applied immediately, and other Monitor instances pick them up on their next refresh.
